agreement.title: Withdraw agreement
agreement.content:
USDT to USD Off-Ramp Service Agreement

1. Service Scope
Party A provides services, through its platform or authorized third-party providers, to convert USDT into USD and remit funds to Party B's designated bank account.

2. Settlement (T+3)
The standard processing period is T+3 business days (excluding weekends and public holidays), commencing from the time the USDT transfer reaches blockchain finality.

3. Third-Party Provider
Party B acknowledges that remittances may be executed by third-party processors or banking partners. Party A shall not be liable for delays or losses caused by banking systems or intermediary banks.

4. Accuracy of Info
The recipient bank account name must match Party B's KYC identity. Party A is not liable for any fund loss caused by inaccurate information provided by Party B.

5. Rejection Fees
In case of a refund due to incorrect info, bank rejection, or policy limits, Party B shall bear all intermediary fees, return fees, and Party A's administrative charges.

6. FX & Volatility Risk
In case of a refund, funds will be returned in USDT at the prevailing market rate. Party B shall bear all risks and losses arising from price volatility during this period.

7. Tax Obligations
Party B is solely responsible for all tax reporting and payments related to this transaction. Party A provides no tax advice and assumes no withholding liabilities.

8. Restricted Regions
Party A does not serve jurisdictions subject to international sanctions (e.g., OFAC) or local prohibitions. Party B bears all losses if funds are seized due to local regulatory restrictions.

9. Jurisdiction
This Agreement is governed by the laws of Poland. In case of any discrepancy, the English version shall prevail.
